title: From Conceptual EneMonIE to an Executable Backend: A Modular Architecture for Energy Information Extractionand Grounded Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2610.17243v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The original EneMonIE proposal describes a Web-based semantic system for continuously monitoring energy trends through targeted information extraction from heterogeneous online media. This article presents EneMonIE-Backend, an implementation-derived redesign that converts that conceptual pipeline into a modular, executable, and application-independent backend. The architecture separates five concerns: data sources, acquisition and normalization, semantic processing, knowledge organization, and persistent storage. It operationalizes configurable connectors for RSS feeds, URL collections, arXiv, social-media JSON files, and open-data CSV files; it also introduces question-driven Web search and scraping. Relevant documents pass through energy categorization, named entity recognition, temporal and event extraction, source sensitive sentiment analysis, and extractive summarization. translated_title: 从概念性EneMonIE到可执行后端：面向能源信息抽取与有据问答的模块化架构
translated_abstract: 原始的EneMonIE提案描述了一个基于Web的语义系统，通过对异构在线媒体进行针对性信息抽取来持续监测能源趋势。本文提出EneMonIE-Backend，这是一项源自实现的重设计，将该概念性流水线转化为模块化、可执行且与应用无关的后端。该架构分离了五个关注层面：数据源、采集与规范化、语义处理、知识组织以及持久化存储。系统实现了可配置的连接器，支持RSS源、URL集合、arXiv、社交媒体JSON文件和开放数据CSV文件；同时引入了问题驱动的Web搜索与网页抓取机制。相关文档依次经过能源分类、命名实体识别、时间与事件抽取、源敏感的情感分析以及抽取式摘要处理。所生成的语义表示支持实体共现分析（原文此处被截断），并可支撑有据问答应用。
tldr: 本文将概念性的EneMonIE能源监测系统落地为一个模块化、可执行且与应用无关的后端架构，通过五层关注点分离设计实现多源异构数据的采集、语义信息抽取与知识组织，为有据问答提供支撑。
en_tdlr: This paper transforms the conceptual EneMonIE energy monitoring system into a modular, executable, and application-independent backend that, through a five-fold separation of concerns, enables multi-source data acquisition, semantic information extraction, and grounded question answering.
